description: With MaxZoomFactor 1.0 there is no hover zoom; changing it to 2.0 at runtime scales the same hovered item to exactly 2x.

assertions.comment: The saved minimum MaxZoomFactor of 1.0 applies to the DockItem.
When MaxZoomFactor is 1.0, hovering the icon center causes no zoom.
The maximum zoom scale of 2.0 takes effect in the frame after the runtime setting change.
The target scale for the item under the centered cursor is immediately calculated as 2.0, matching the setting.

When MaxZoomFactor is raised to 2.0, the icon under the cursor reaches the new maximum scale. Note: this path jumps about 96% in one frame without easing (hover zoom grows smoothly over 9 frames). It is kept as a defect candidate and fixes only the reached value; making it smooth still passes this assertion.

The path that changes the maximum scale through settings does not determine whether it is animated. The first-frame delta varies from 39–96% of the range between runs because QUnifiedTimer registers newly started animations late, so smooth motion cannot be distinguished from a jump. The mouse-hover zoom path verifies the curve in the hover-zoom scenario. Here, verify only that the new maximum scale is reached.
